traits.leaf_width_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Elymus glaucus: blades 8 mm to 1.5 cm wide.

traits.culm_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Elymus glaucus: culms 60 cm to 1.2 m tall.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Elymus glaucus: panicle 5 cm to 20 cm long.

appearance.organs.panicle.note: The spike's layout, the model's choice after FNA (volume 24), as search results quote it (the page was not read): usually 2 spikelets a node, appressed to slightly divergent. Drawn as 12 nodes of 2 spikelets in one plane, each node turned half a turn. Colours by eye: blue-green.

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (volume 24), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): spikes 5 to 21 cm, erect to slightly nodding, rarely somewhat pendent, usually with 2 spikelets a node; spikelets 8 to 25 mm, appressed to slightly divergent, with (1)2 to 4(6) florets; glume bodies (6)9 to 14(19) mm, both glumes alike; lemmas (8)9 to 14(16) mm; awns (0)1 to 30(35) mm (the lemma and awn figures as the search results gave them).

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a loose bunchgrass with broad, flat, bluish blades and tall culms ending in slender, bristly spikes. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1.1 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: blue-green blades; green to straw spikes.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.life_span.note: Hitchcock (p. 253, no. 12) gives its season symbol as perennial; the genus (p. 246) holds perennials and one annual.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Hitchcock (p. 253, no. 12): culms in loose to dense tufts, without rhizomes (Abrams 1923, no. 12: without rhizomes).

traits.clonal.note: Hitchcock (p. 253, no. 12): tufted, without rhizomes, so it does not spread beyond its tuft.

traits.awn_insertion.note: Hitchcock's genus description of Elymus (p. 246): lemmas acute or usually awned from the tip; for E. glaucus (p. 253) the lemmas are awned, the awn one to two times the body's length.

traits.awn_form.note: Hitchcock (p. 253, no. 12): the awn held erect to spreading, with no knee or twist named.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 1 (Elymus no. 12, fig. 600): flowers June-August in open woods and dry hillsides.

traits.fruiting_months.note: FEIS's blue wildrye review (Johnson 1999, read 2026-10-16): in California "seed ripens in early July in the foothills and in late August at higher elevations"; read as July and August.
